name: Security routing

trigger.label: When Campus chooses who picks a task up

confirmation.title: Enable this Rule?
confirmation.body: Enabling this Rule narrows who Campus may hand its tasks to: when Campus chooses who picks a task up, and when an Office asks for its next task, only this Rule's destinations that Campus's own eligibility allows are offered. One eligible destination is assigned directly; several go to the reviewer to choose among; none lets Campus choose from every eligible Office. It makes no model requests of its own.

confirmation.title: Archive this Rule?
confirmation.body: Archiving disables this Rule and keeps its revisions and run history.

summary: Routes P0, P1 tasks to Scout and security department.

lock.label: Editable workspace rule
lock.explanation: This Rule belongs to this Island.

precedence.label: The Rule narrows; Campus still chooses
precedence.description: Campus's own eligibility (capability, provider, credential, rate limits, recent failed starts and staffing) stays authoritative. The Rule keeps only its destinations among the eligible Offices. One left is assigned directly; several go to the reviewer to choose among; none leaves the Rule skipped, recorded in run history, and Campus chooses from every eligible Office. An Office pulling work itself is offered only tasks whose routing Rules include it.
